reapack.name: Combined_CC_Tool.lua
reapack.desc: Combined CC Tool - Removing redundant CCs and smoothing selected CCs

version.author: drvlat
version.changelog: Fixed race condition in context updates — centralized get_midi_context() function Fixed incorrect redundant event calculation (first event no longer falsely flagged) Fixed potential infinite loop in CC removal — now uses two-pass reverse deletion Optimized CC selection counting with caching and invalidation flags

reapack.name: Legato_Tool.lua
reapack.desc: Legato Tool - Creating legato effects and stuff

version.author: drvlat
version.changelog: Added is_notes_cache_valid() to prevent drag operations from using stale cached data Added boundary constraint support to heal_overlays when keep_within_boundaries is enabled Added MIDI_Sort calls in restore_original_notes, fill_gaps, and apply_legato for correct event ordering Improved cache cleanup on undo/redo, context changes, and apply — resets last_selected_note_indices Drag now falls back to fresh cache build when cached notes are invalid
